baseline.rationale: The report is tightly focused on META at 2026-07-30 and correctly anchors on the frozen close of 539.03 and the Q2 2026 release. Earnings figures are quoted with correct period and units (quarterly revenue 60.801B, operating income 18.775B, margin 31% vs 43%, capex 31.08B), and the report explicitly refuses to compute any trailing P/E or TTM EPS, repeatedly labeling valuation UNKNOWN — so the semantic gate passes cleanly. Derived arithmetic (3.58B one-offs, ~5.9% of revenue, ~51% capex/revenue, prior-year operating income ~20.41B, gap −10.18%, close-to-close −7.95%, 1.89x volume, 10.23 points below lower band) is all traceable to cited operands and is correctly labeled as calculation rather than sourced fact. The one substantive defect is in the News Analyst section, which asserts the corpus provides 'no prior-close, no volume, and no technical indicator series' and that the post-earnings reaction cannot be computed — directly contradicted by the observed get_stock_data and get_indicators outputs, and inconsistent with the rest of the report which uses those very figures. That is a self-inflicted evidence-availability error rather than a fabrication of numbers, so support lands at 0.9 rather than 1.0. Minor uncited price restatements in the Aggressive/Conservative sections are cosmetic since the same figures are cited elsewhere. Overall the report is well-grounded, appropriately hedged, and the HOLD decision is supported by the evidence.

Every earnings figure (revenue 60.801B +28%, operating income 18.775B -8%, margin 31% vs 43%, 2.40B legal + 1.18B severance, DAP 3.60B +3%, capex 31.08B) matches the frozen src-meta notes exactly. Derived figures (gap -7.96%, capex/revenue ~51%, pro-forma operating income ~22.36B / ~37% margin, 3.58B add-back) are correctly labeled as calculations and arithmetically sound. The report explicitly refuses to fabricate unavailable data (macro, prediction markets, TTM EPS) and marks valuation as UNKNOWN — a strength, not a gap. Only minor imprecision: the 'five of six down sessions' count is loosely supported by the cited series. Relevance: Fully on-task for META / 2026-07-30, with a coherent multi-role structure culminating in a clear Underweight rating and SELL proposal; some redundancy across the four risk-analyst sections but no off-topic drift. Semantic validity: No period/unit errors — the report never converts a quarterly figure to TTM/annual, never computes a trailing P/E from quarterly EPS, and explicitly flags trailing P/E as UNKNOWN for lack of TTM EPS evidence. The pro-forma margin is correctly framed as a derived calculation, not a reported figure. No unsupported numerical valuation assertion.
